title: Token Slice Origami: Interactive cost-slice architect & export patterns
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design an interactive 'slice architect' UI for token-level cost analytics that lets customers compose, inspect, and export orthogonal cost slices (model variant, prompt family, route, and time window). The feature emphasizes quick chargeback exports, pivot-style CSV templates, and curated pricing presets (flat, per-token, and hybrid tiers). This ticket covers explorative prototypes, a low-fidelity flow for structured exports, usability testing with two customers, and design handoff artifacts for eng implementation. The UX should surface weighted attribution heuristics (anchor-based prompt attribution), per-route breakdown sparklines, and an export mapping editor that avoids heavy manual CSV transformations.
tasks: Sketch 3 high-level interaction models (pivot canvas, guided composer, rules editor)
Create Figma prototype for the guided composer with 4 slice dimensions and live cost preview
Define CSV/JSON export templates and mapping rules for chargeback systems
Run 3 moderated usability sessions with existing Dedicated customers
Synthesize usability findings and finalize acceptance criteria
Prepare dev-ready spec and tokens-to-cost mapping table for ENG handoff
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates composing a cost slice combining model, prompt-set, route, and 7-day window
User can save/export at least 3 template presets (Chargeback CSV, Pivot CSV, System JSON)
Design doc includes mapping for weighted attribution + fallback rules and example outputs
Usability test NPS delta >= +10 on understanding cost drivers vs baseline console view
Design reviewed by PM and signed off for console-2026.04 release
comments: 2026-02-18 - Maya Patel: Initial sketches done. Major trade-off: full pivot canvas is powerful but heavy — proposing a hybrid guided composer that surfaces the 4 most-used dimensions first.

2026-02-22 - Diego Martinez (PM): Agreed on hybrid approach. Priority to support export templates for chargeback systems (finance teams). Please include sample column mappings used by two enterprise customers.
2026-03-01 - Research: Three usability sessions scheduled (Feb 26, Feb 28, Mar 03). Early feedback: users want preview row counts and an estimated monthly cost projection when selecting slices.

2026-03-06 - Design critique: Add an explicit 'attribution confidence' indicator when attribution relies on heuristics (prompt-anchor matching). Anthony (Eng) flagged potential perf issues for live preview on huge datasets — added dependency ENG-3128 for server-side preview endpoints.
2026-03-10 - Prototype v0.2 posted. Figma link in assets. Notes: introduced pricing preset editor (flat/per-token/hybrid) and a simple rules UI to drop-in custom multipliers for enterprise discounts.
2026-03-12 - PM review: Approved for usability rounds pending clarifications on export schema. Action: include sample JSON schema and example rows for Finance export.
2026-03-14 - Maya Patel: Incorporated test results — reduced cognitive load by collapsing rarely used dimensions into 'Advanced slices' panel. Preparing final handoff spec and DEV checklist.
